title: Weak Signal Record (v0)
description: One candidate microstructure signal in the Microstructure Observatory. Exists to prevent 'not proven' from silently becoming 'zero'. A record NEVER confers fitness, promotion, or scheduling advantage on any organism or lineage; it is preserved evidence, not a reward. Records are never deleted; state transitions are appended, never rewritten. SFE remains authoritative history (evidence references point into the ledger); PEW owns evolving interpretation (append-only annotations).

signal_id.description: content-derived id over (hypothesis, first-evidence refs); duplicate registration is idempotent

state.description: PRESERVED: recorded, below even the permissive flag. UNRESOLVED_WEAK_SIGNAL: permissive test fired; zero consequences; may persist for millions of encounters. UNDER_INVESTIGATION: preregistered extra luminosity being spent (admitted by lottery/FIFO within a fixed budget slice, never top-k by effect size). ADMITTED_MICROSTRUCTURE: survived held-out directional replication + invariance profile + pseudo-signal battery under the admission-family FDR bound. EXPLAINED_ARTIFACT: attributed to a named nuisance process (which one, in explanation). RETIRED_UNDERPOWERED: luminosity budget exhausted without resolution -- explicitly NOT evidence of absence; remains mineable.

signal_class.description: A: small repeated nonzero paired effects. B: no single coordinate compelling, several move together. C: consistent directional trajectory across related mutations. INTERACTION_ONLY: effect exists only in dP x dW. CURVATURE: reproducible local slope/interaction structure.

detector_version.description: content hash of the Observatory analysis code that computed this record

null_version.description: content hash of the null construction (block definition, permutation scheme, e-process spec)

observable_family_hash.description: hash of the frozen V0 observable family definition. Records computed under different family versions are never pooled.

hypothesis.description: FROZEN at investigation start. The candidate is never modified to enlarge its effect; enlarging luminosity is the only permitted response to weakness.

family_id.description: preregistered hypothesis family this signal belongs to; families generated by retrospective PEW mining carry a fresh evidence budget and a lineage back to the mining proposal

subject.description: what the hypothesis is about: player hash(es), world hash(es), lineage id(s), perturbation direction(s)

predicted_direction.description: the preregistered sign/direction in mu-space that held-out replication must reproduce

frozen_ledger_seq.description: commit boundary seq sealing the hypothesis; null = preservation-only record, exploratory

evidence.description: References only -- the ledger and content-addressed artifacts hold the raw evidence. A record whose evidence cannot be replayed is not evidence. RED-TEAM EXTENSION: the retrospective joins PEW is licensed to perform are impossible without block identities, seed-derivation paths, and cohort denominators -- a miner must be able to DETECT that two records share blocks, or PEW-derived families are built on invisible pseudo-replication.

twin_set_refs.description: match ids / twin-set ids of every encounter contributing

block_structure.description: content address of the block definition used (which encounters form which exchangeable units)

block_ids.description: per-unit (founder-cluster x world-family x seed-block) identifiers WITH seed-derivation paths -- mandatory for pseudo-replication detection across records

reference_twin_refs.description: the matched reference/control twins the conditional ranks were computed against -- the UNFLAGGED cohort is part of the evidence, not discardable context

probe_cohort_denominator.description: total probes run under this (detector x null x budget epoch) at flag time -- without it no retrospective base-rate or regression-to-mean correction is computable

flag_count_percentile.description: this subject's flag-count percentile under the analytic null flag rate -- stamped so that 'flagged 7 times across 3 detector versions' cannot masquerade as convergent evidence when it is the expected extreme of thousands of null lineages

funnel_state.description: selection state within the Observatory's own funnel at record time

expansion_version.description: world/genome expansion code version -- cross-epoch joins must not conflate substrate semantic changes with signal drift

alpha_wealth_snapshot.description: content address of the GLOBAL family-generation alpha-wealth ledger state at family opening (families are debited at CREATION; the family process, not just each family, is priced)

mu_delta.description: the microstructure vector difference (versioned coordinates; see microstructure_vector schema)

uncertainty.description: per-coordinate uncertainty under the block null (permutation quantiles / e-value)

e_value.description: current accumulated evidence under the preregistered e-process; null before investigation

outcome_free.description: true when aggregate outcome shows no detectable change -- explicitly first-class: the interesting object may lose every game

invariance_profile.description: one entry per preregistered axis: seeds, hosts, world_siblings, player_siblings, observation_permutations, resource_budgets, opponent_mixtures, delayed_replication, architecture_ablations. A tiny stable effect outranks a huge fragile one for investigation priority.

capability_vector.description: Present when the signal is a reproducible local DIRECTION: perturbation delta -> Delta-mu direction. The name implies nothing about intelligence.

perturbation_distribution_hash.description: the FROZEN distribution the perturbation was drawn from -- directions are only meaningful relative to a preregistered fan, never a hand-picked delta

ecology_snapshot.description: content address of the opponent-population snapshot at first detection

explanation.description: for EXPLAINED_ARTIFACT: which named nuisance process (from the pseudo-signal taxonomy) accounts for it, with evidence refs

interpretations.description: APPEND-ONLY annotations owned by PEW. Interpretation text NEVER enters mu, any threshold, or any admission decision; an LLM-generated grouping recorded here is a PROPOSAL whose confirmation requires a new prospective family with a fresh evidence budget.

proposes_family.description: id of a new prospective hypothesis family this interpretation spawned, if any

state_history.description: append-only; a record's past states are never rewritten

$comment: DESIGN RULES: (1) no field may ever feed selection, promotion, or scheduling of the SUBJECT lineage -- Observatory encounters are sterile for evolution; (2) RETIRED_UNDERPOWERED is not 'zero' -- the record and its evidence stay mineable forever; (3) admission is FDR-bounded across the admission family via alpha-investing; the family ledger charges every admission attempt; (4) records computed under different observable_family_hash values are never pooled into one statistic.
